footer_description:
Reconstructing iEnhancer-2L and connecting
sequence predictions with experimental evidence.
evidence_labels: Published findings, local observations, and proposed analyses are identified separately.
hero_title: Enhancers: Exploring the signals that control genes
hero_description: Reconstruct and evaluate iEnhancer-2L, then compare its predictions with experimental activity. We chose HepG2, K562, and WTC11 because Agarwal, Inoue et al. (Nature, 2025) tested the same DNA sequences in all three using lentiMPRA. Those matched measurements can reveal where the method’s predictions are useful and where they fall short.
hero_alt: A glowing vertical DNA double helix made of binary digits rotates against a dark background. A continuously looping conceptual animation.
visual_caption: Follow the sequence. Evaluate the evidence.
report_notice: Historical report · 10 October 2026. This report preserves the original strategy. The active project now focuses on iEnhancer-2L and a planned comparison with matched activity measurements from Agarwal, Inoue et al. (Nature, 2025). HepG2, K562, and WTC11 were chosen because that study tested the same DNA in all three. Earlier multi-method plans and the MCSE/VISTA work are historical context. Follow the current roadmap, iEnhancer-2L results, and MCSE archive for their present status. The report below retains its original priorities, dates, and counts.
